--- title: "Crime Data Set" author: Meenakshi date: "2025-10-13" categories: Assessment 2 description: EDA of the "crimedataset" format: html --- # Homicide in Nine US Cities (2015) In 2015, homicide rates in nine major U.S. cities showed a worrying increase following years of decline. Cities such as Chicago, St. Louis, Detroit, and New Orleans experienced significant rises in the number of killings, with some cities reporting rates higher than the national average. This increase was often linked to exacerbated social tensions, economic challenges, and an uptick in gun violence. The data reflects a complex interplay of factors including policing policies, community relations, and socio-economic conditions influencing these urban crime trends.
